description: Product Name: Power BI Baidu ECharts K-line Visualization Object Version: 1.0.0 Release date: December 3, 2024 Developer: [Infortime Shiqin] Main functions: 1. Data driven visualization: Users can directly drive K-line charts through Power BI's data model to achieve dynamic data display. 2. Highly customizable: Provides multiple customization options, including color, line type, legend position, etc., to meet the display needs of different users. 3. Interactivity: Supports interactive operations such as mouse hovering and clicking, enhancing user experience. 4. Responsive design: K-line charts can adapt to different display devices and resolutions. 5. Multi language support: Supports multiple languages to meet the needs of global users. Usage scenario: -Stock market analysis: Display the trend of stock prices over time. -Transaction volume monitoring: Monitor changes in transaction volume during a specific time period. -Economic indicator tracking: tracking and comparing the changes of different economic indicators over time. -Performance analysis: Display the fluctuation of project or product performance indicators over time. This visualization object aims to provide Power BI users with an innovative and feature rich way of presenting data, helping them better understand and analyze time series data.
